run_wav2vec_featurize: run the wav2vec featurize script to pre-compute embeddings for a flashlight dataset using a pretrained model
create_PretrainedWav2VecModel: create a PretrainedWav2VecModel from a checkpoint file to extract feature and context vectors from audio
create_Prediction: create a Prediction wrapper to extract wav2vec embeddings from raw audio waveforms on a GPU
create_H5Writer: create an H5Writer to save feature arrays as HDF5 files in flashlight compatible format
create_EmbeddingDatasetWriter: create an EmbeddingDatasetWriter to pre-compute and store wav2vec embeddings for a dataset split
